description:
The mercenary Tened gathers information to find his younger brother. One day, he gets a clue that his missing younger brother is related to the Great Chapel. Tened is assigned to escort a carriage to the Great Chapel, and the mission, which he thought would proceed smoothly, falls into chaos due to an attack by heretics. As a result, the carriage he was escorting catches fire, and Tened hurriedly opens the carriage door to take out the holy relic. However, instead of the holy relic, there is a child sitting in the carriage...

Tened rescues the child without hesitation and escapes from the heretics. After that, Tened sets out on a journey to take the child to the Great Chapel, and the child feels strange feelings when he sees Tened being kind to him.

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)
